purpose: Declarative contracts for unified artifact lookup, open-work listing, and artifact lifecycle navigation.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Get a unified artifact (improvement or task) by artifact_key. Artifact key format: {type}:{project}:{local_id}.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List unified artifacts with optional filtering. Use this as the primary search surface for improvements and tasks together.

status.description: Filter by status (open, done, paused, archived)

type.description: Filter by type (improvement, task, or null for both)

created_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include artifacts with created_at >= this value

created_before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include artifacts with created_at <= this value

updated_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include artifacts with updated_at >= this value

updated_before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include artifacts with updated_at <= this value

tools.name: list_open_tasks
tools.description: List open project work items through the unified artifact surface. This is the preferred MCP surface for open-work inspection.

artifact_type.description: Filter open work by unified artifact type. all returns tasks and orphan/open improvements.

created_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include tasks with created_at >= this value

created_before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include tasks with created_at <= this value

updated_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include tasks with updated_at >= this value

updated_before.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; include tasks with updated_at <= this value

claim_filter.description: Filter by task lease state. available hides active claims, claimed returns occupied tasks, all returns both with task_claim annotations.

include_claims.description: Annotate returned tasks with task_claim, claim_status, and claim_available.

tools.name: resolve_artifact
tools.description: Resolve a unified artifact and automatically sync status with linked artifact if exists.

tools.name: reopen_artifact
tools.description: Reopen a unified artifact and automatically sync status with linked artifact if exists.
